summary:
Added a `/change-password` page for signed-in users, linked from the welcome page.

- `src/pages/ChangePassword.jsx` (new): current password, new password, confirm new password. Redirects to `/login` if nobody is signed in (same guard as Welcome), verifies the current password, then updates the stored account via `saveUser` and returns to `/welcome`.
- `src/components/PasswordRules.jsx` (new): the project's five password rules and their check, per the recorded convention that rules live in one shared module rather than being re-declared per page. This repo's branch didn't yet have the file, so I created it; the new-password field shows the rules as a muted hint list and unmet rules turn error-coloured on submit, blocking the change.
- `src/App.jsx`: registered `/change-password` in the routes map. `src/pages/Welcome.jsx`: "Change password" link. `src/style.css`: `.rules` / `.rule-failed`.

Reading taken: the smaller one — a single page under the existing localStorage demo store, no backend call. Build passes.
blockers: Not applied -- Server-side password change endpoint: belongs to the separate backend repository; this app's demo account store is localStorage-only, matching existing sign-up/log-in
conventions: Passwords must be at least 8 characters and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number and one special character (any non-alphanumeric)
Wherever a password is chosen (sign up, reset, change), the five rules are always displayed under the password field and unmet rules are marked in error colour on submit, blocking submission
Password rules and their checks come from src/components/PasswordRules.jsx — do not re-declare them per page
Pages are components in src/pages/ registered by path in the src/App.jsx routes map
Pages that require a signed-in user redirect to /login when currentUser() is null

visual_check.evidence: verifier did not return parseable JSON

context_sharing.notes: There is no HTTP API here at all: these files implement a client-only React SPA whose persistence is localStorage key 'acme-users' (email-keyed map of User) and sessionStorage key 'acme-current' (email string), via src/store.js (findUser, saveUser, setCurrentUser, currentUser). The only 'paths' are client-side routes in src/App.jsx: '/signup', '/login', '/welcome', '/change-password', with any unknown path falling back to Signup. Password rules (8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, special) are enforced only in src/components/PasswordRules.jsx on the client, so any server counterpart must re-validate them independently.
